summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: tslint-folder-schema@1.0.7 declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (string-array shuffle with rotating array and shift routine, `_0x`-style identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker) that is not referenced by the package's `main` entry and has no relation to any tslint rule functionality. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time bypasses Node-based tooling and runs arbitrary attacker code on the installer's machine before the developer ever imports the package. The package's advertised purpose (a tslint folder-schema rule), its `files` manifest (which does not declare `math_init.js`), and its author metadata (a personal gmail address versus the servicetitan/folder-lint repository referenced in the homepage) do not match the shipped contents, consistent with impersonation of a legitimate lint helper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
